decisions.Kwic: 時有僧出礼拜師云不是作家出去

Decision.AttributionNote: Transmission of the Lamp, Jade Flowers Collection, fragment (傳燈玉英集（殘卷）): the section heading names Qingping Weikuang; after a monk steps out and bows during Qingping's hall address, Qingping says he is not an adept and sends him out.

decisions.Kwic: 夫律師者啟毗尼之法藏傳壽命之遺風洞持犯而達開遮秉威儀

Decision.AttributionNote: Transmission of the Lamp, Jade Flowers Collection, fragment (傳燈玉英集（殘卷）): in the long question-and-answer record of Dazhu Huihai, Dazhu describes the Vinaya master as thoroughly understanding observance and transgression and mastering permission and prohibition.
